questions.question: Name the parts of 3x² − 5x + 7: terms, variable, coefficients, constant, exponents.
questions.expected_answer: Three terms: 3x², −5x and 7. Variable x. Coefficients 3 and −5. Constant 7. Exponent 2 on x in the first term, 1 in the second.

questions.question: Why are 3x and 3x² unlike terms even though both have coefficient 3?
questions.expected_answer: Like terms need identical variable parts including exponents. x and x² differ in exponent, so they are different kinds of thing — like a metre and a square metre — and cannot be collected.

questions.question: Explain the difference between 2(x + 3) and 2x + 3 in words.
questions.expected_answer: 2(x + 3) is twice the sum of a number and three: add first, then double. 2x + 3 is the sum of twice a number and three: double first, then add three. For x = 1 they give 8 and 5.
